name: KenMont and KenWood Camps
description_short: Overnight brother/sister camps: KenMont Camp for Boys and KenWood Camp for Girls. Campers entering grades 2–10 can choose a four-week session or one of two two-week options.
refund_policy_summary: All payments except credit card fees are fully refundable until January 21. Payment schedule: $1,500 deposit per camper with the application, $4,000 per camper due January 25, and the balance due March 1. The required uniform is extra and is bought directly from The Camp Spot.

warnings: The early-enrollment discount ($350 off, or $250 for the 2-week option, if enrolled by September 30, 2026) has already passed as of today, so the listed full prices should apply.
Extra charges are not included in tuition: a Personal / Trip Day Expense of $400 ($300 for the 2-week option), plus a required uniform bought from The Camp Spot.

The page gives the price of the 2-week option once, $7,600. It is assumed here that each of the two 2-week periods costs $7,600 and can be booked on its own. The page wording does not make this fully clear.
On the 2-week option, transportation is included on arrival day only. The 4-week sessions include both arrival and departure days.
The refund deadline (January 21) and the $4,000 payment due date (January 25) do not name a year. They are probably 2027.
